### What workflow should improve?

Describe what you want to do and what prevents it today.

### Proposed behavior

Explain what the user would see or type. For a terminal adapter, describe how the focused session and remote destination could be identified.

### Environments you can test

List terminal clients, operating systems, shells, and connection methods.

### Roadmap context

Link a related issue or section of docs/roadmap.md if relevant.
